description: Hotel and Restaurant Furniture in Vijayawada manufactures furniture for hotels, restaurants and cafeterias, including dining tables, hotel chairs, restaurant chairs and sofa seating. Visit us on Ambapuram Road near Karthikeya hospital, Andhra prabha colony, 4th line, Sing Nager, Vijayawada.
